classified_changes.relation: Original carries AX=i from its loop test, shifts it twice, loads SI=w.offset and ES=w.segment, adds 0x2C and AX, then LDS BX,ES:[SI]. Current reloads i into SI, shifts SI twice, adds w.offset, loads ES=w.segment, then LDS BX,ES:[SI+0x2C]. Both read the same far pointer at segment w.segment and offset (w.offset+4*i+0x2C) mod 65536.
classified_changes.live_state: DS:BX becomes the identical object pointer. Old SI is table address, new SI is table address-0x2C; SI is overwritten before use by the iterative loop and finally restored. AX is overwritten by the common following rectangle-word load. The loop test defines flags before branching.

classified_changes.relation: Original AX=i; CMP n,AX; JG body. Current AX=n; CMP i,AX; JL body. Both enter iff signed i<signed n, including n<=0. The old AX=i carry feeds its first address calculation; current calculation explicitly reloads i.
classified_changes.live_state: Branch successors agree; body-address relation above accounts for the deliberate AX carry difference. After loop, common MOV AX,DGROUP restores identical state.

classified_changes.relation: Original forms AX=4*BX, loads ES:SI=w, adds 0x2C and AX, then LES SI,ES:[SI]. Current forms SI=4*BX, adds w.offset, loads ES=w.segment, then LES SI,ES:[SI+0x2C]. Both load the identical far object pointer at (w.offset+4*i+0x2C) mod 65536.
classified_changes.live_state: ES:SI and [bp-1E]/[bp-1C] agree. AX differs until redefined: it is not read by TEST/Jcc/push/LEA or, on the no-autosize arm, before common MOV AX,[bp-1E]. Autosize entry receives explicit object pointer and hidden result pointer; AX is volatile and unused as a helper argument.

classified_changes.relation: Original adds 0x2C to BX=w.offset then pushes ES:[BX+DI+2] and ES:[BX+DI]. Current retains BX=w.offset and pushes ES:[BX+DI+0x2E] and ES:[BX+DI+0x2C]. With DI=4*i, both push segment then offset of the same far Rect pointer. Removing ADD (3 bytes) and enlarging both operand displacements by one byte each saves one byte.
classified_changes.live_state: Both stack words and the f_2505_0511 call target agree. BX is volatile and not an argument of f_2505_0511. That helper defines BX using its far parameter before any read; subsequent LES BX reloads w.
